description:
Instrument the TUI render hot path so we can observe — with numbers — what happens to keyboard latency while a streaming response is being rendered. All events register with `OctoPi.Tracer` and flow to the existing `FileBackend` log via the `--log-telemetry=PATH` CLI flag (`apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/cli.ex:147-149, :301`).

## Code references

- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex:513-524` — `handle_info` clauses for `{:hid_event, _}` and `{:octo_pi_agent_event, _}`. This is where `handle_info` spans wrap and where `mailbox_len_before` is sampled.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex:1536-1537, :1603-1614` — `update_transcript`/`apply_partial` paths called per stream chunk; wrap with `transcript.render` span.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex:1754, :2197-2198` — assistant message render call; wrap individual `markdown.render` spans here.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/markdown.ex:40-50` — actual Earmark + render call; alternative span site if cleaner.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui_terminal/lib/octo_pi/tui/terminal.ex:325` — `narrowcast/2`; capture key arrival timestamp here, before the `{:hid_event, _}` is sent.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/application.ex:8-46` — tracer registrations to extend.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/render_loop.ex:82-89` — existing example of `:telemetry.execute` with metadata and measurement maps; follow this style.
- `apps/octo_pi_tracer/lib/octo_pi/tracer.ex:14-37` — registration API (`OctoPi.Tracer.register/1`) and shape of `events_list` / `events_by_level` specs.

## Events

| Event | Type | Measurements | Metadata |
|---|---|---|---|
| `[:octo_pi_tui, :interactive, :handle_info, :start \| :stop]` | `:telemetry.span` | duration | `%{kind: :hid_event \| :octo_pi_agent_event \| :render_tick \| <other>, mailbox_len_before}` |
| `[:octo_pi_tui, :transcript, :render, :start \| :stop]` | `:telemetry.span` | duration | `%{streaming?: bool, msg_count, line_count}` |
| `[:octo_pi_tui, :markdown, :render, :start \| :stop]` | `:telemetry.span` | duration | `%{text_bytes, width, line_count, streaming?: bool, msg_id}` |
| `[:octo_pi_tui, :key, :latency]` | `:telemetry.execute` | `%{duration_us}` (arrival in `Terminal.narrowcast/2` → handled in `Interactive`) | `%{key, mailbox_len_at_arrival}` |
| `[:octo_pi_tui, :interactive, :mailbox]` | `:telemetry.execute` | `%{message_queue_len}` | `%{at: :handle_info_entry}` |

## Wiring

- Use `:telemetry.span/3` for duration events (start/stop pair, exception-safe). Lift the kind/metadata into the start map.
- `mailbox_len_before` from `Process.info(self(), :message_queue_len)` at the top of each `handle_info` clause, before any work.
- For `key.latency`: stamp `System.monotonic_time(:microsecond)` into the `{:hid_event, _}` payload at `terminal.ex:325` (or a parallel pid → time table); subtract at the moment `Interactive` invokes its key handler. Capturing the timestamp at narrowcast is essential — measuring at `handle_info` only would hide the queueing delay, which is the value we care about.
- `streaming?` metadata is load-bearing; without it a single trace can't distinguish per-chunk renders from a final/idle render. Drive it from whether a `MessageEnd` for the assistant message has been seen.
- `msg_id` for `markdown.render` comes from the `OctoPi.Agent.Event.MessageUpdate` / `MessageEnd` payload's message struct; pass it through the render call sites.

## Tracer registration

In `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/application.ex`:

- Extend `:tui_render` events list with `[:octo_pi_tui, :transcript, :render, :start | :stop]` and `[:octo_pi_tui, :markdown, :render, :start | :stop]`.
- Add a new spec `:tui_interactive` at `:debug` for `[:octo_pi_tui, :interactive, :handle_info, :start | :stop]`, `[:octo_pi_tui, :interactive, :mailbox]`, and `[:octo_pi_tui, :key, :latency]`.

## Acceptance

- All five events fire during a streaming `mix pi` run with `--log-telemetry=.pi/trace.log`; the file contains a usable record of one streaming turn that can be filtered by event name.
- `:telemetry.span` start/stop pairs balance (no orphan starts on exception paths).
- Idle overhead is sub-millisecond per `handle_info` — verified by a no-stream interactive session showing the new spans dominated by mailbox-empty time.
- New events appear in `mix pi info trace` (or whatever the equivalent tracer-listing command is — see `apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/cli.ex:125`).

## Tests

Add or extend `apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/tracer_handlers_test.exs` (existing pattern) to assert each new event's measurements/metadata shape against captured telemetry handlers.
title: Add render-path telemetry to observe streaming keyboard latency
